package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
)

const coursePlanColumns = `id, student_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, goal_code, learning_path_id, intent_json, status,
result_code, course_id, reused, course_fingerprint, fingerprint_version,
normalized_context_json, generated_course_json, failure_code, attempts, claim_token, lease_until,
next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at, completed_at,
path_command_kind, path_command_expected_version, path_command_hash, path_command_payload, path_command_checkpointed_at,
path_command_result_code, path_command_course_id, path_command_reused, diagnostic_plan_id`

func (store Store) CreateOrGet(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error) {
	row := store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
INSERT INTO course_plan_request(
    id, student_id, idempotency_key, request_hash, goal_code, learning_path_id, diagnostic_plan_id, intent_json, status,
    attempts, next_attempt_at, created_at, updated_at
) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,NULLIF($6::text,'')::uuid,NULLIF($7::text,'')::uuid,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12,$13)
ON CONFLICT (student_id, idempotency_key)
DO UPDATE SET idempotency_key = course_plan_request.idempotency_key
RETURNING `+coursePlanColumns,
		request.ID, request.StudentID, request.IdempotencyKey, request.RequestHash, request.GoalCode, request.LearningPathID, request.DiagnosticPlanID,
		mustJSON(request.Intent), request.Status, request.Attempts, request.NextAttemptAt, request.CreatedAt, request.UpdatedAt,
	)
	stored, err := scanCoursePlan(row)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, err
	}
	if stored.RequestHash != request.RequestHash {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, false, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return stored, stored.ID == request.ID, nil
}

func (store Store) GetForStudent(
	ctx context.Context,
	studentID string,
	requestID string,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	request, err := scanCoursePlan(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx,
		`SELECT `+coursePlanColumns+` FROM course_plan_request WHERE id=$1 AND student_id=$2`,
		requestID, studentID,
	))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return request, err
}

func (store Store) GetDiagnosticPlanningRequest(ctx context.Context, studentID, planID string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	rows, err := store.Pool.Query(ctx, `SELECT `+coursePlanColumns+` FROM course_plan_request WHERE student_id=$1 AND diagnostic_plan_id=$2 ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 2`, studentID, planID)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	if !rows.Next() {
		if rows.Err() != nil {
			return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, rows.Err()
		}
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	request, err := scanCoursePlan(rows)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, err
	}
	if rows.Next() {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if rows.Err() != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, rows.Err()
	}
	if request.Intent.Source != domain.PlanningSourceTeacher || request.Intent.Reason != domain.PlanningReasonInitial {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return request, nil
}

func (store Store) ClaimNext(
	ctx context.Context,
	claimToken string,
	now time.Time,
	leaseUntil time.Time,
) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	request, err := scanCoursePlan(store.Pool.QueryRow(ctx, `
WITH candidate AS (
    SELECT id
    FROM course_plan_request
    WHERE status='PLANNING'
      AND next_attempt_at <= $2
      AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= $2)
    ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
    LIMIT 1
)
UPDATE course_plan_request AS request
SET claim_token=$1, lease_until=$3, attempts=request.attempts+1, updated_at=$2
FROM candidate
WHERE request.id=candidate.id
RETURNING `+prefixedCoursePlanColumns("request"), claimToken, now, leaseUntil))
	if errors.Is(err, pgx.ErrNoRows) {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return request, err
}

func (store Store) RenewClaim(
	ctx context.Context,
	requestID string,
	claimToken string,
	now time.Time,
	leaseUntil time.Time,
) error {
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET lease_until=$4, updated_at=$3
WHERE id=$1 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$2`, requestID, claimToken, now, leaseUntil)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (store Store) ResolveLearningPath(
	ctx context.Context,
	requestID string,
	claimToken string,
	learningPathID string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET learning_path_id=$3, updated_at=$4
WHERE id=$1 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$2
  AND (learning_path_id IS NULL OR learning_path_id=$3)`, requestID, claimToken, learningPathID, now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (store Store) CheckpointLearningPathCommand(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	claimToken string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	if request.LearningPathCommand == nil {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	checkpoint, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(
		*request.LearningPathCommand, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	command, err := store.Pool.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET path_command_kind=COALESCE(path_command_kind,$3),
    path_command_expected_version=COALESCE(path_command_expected_version,$4),
    path_command_hash=COALESCE(path_command_hash,$5),
    path_command_payload=COALESCE(path_command_payload,$6::jsonb),
    path_command_checkpointed_at=COALESCE(path_command_checkpointed_at,$7),
    path_command_result_code=COALESCE(path_command_result_code,$8),
    path_command_course_id=COALESCE(path_command_course_id,NULLIF($9::text,'')::uuid),
    path_command_reused=COALESCE(path_command_reused,$10),
    course_fingerprint=CASE WHEN path_command_kind IS NULL THEN NULLIF($11::text,'') ELSE course_fingerprint END,
    fingerprint_version=CASE WHEN path_command_kind IS NULL THEN NULLIF($12::text,'') ELSE fingerprint_version END,
    normalized_context_json=CASE WHEN path_command_kind IS NULL THEN $13 ELSE normalized_context_json END,
    generated_course_json=CASE WHEN path_command_kind IS NULL THEN $14 ELSE generated_course_json END,
    updated_at=$15
WHERE id=$1 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$2 AND learning_path_id IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    (path_command_kind IS NULL AND path_command_expected_version IS NULL AND path_command_hash IS NULL
      AND path_command_payload IS NULL AND path_command_checkpointed_at IS NULL
      AND path_command_result_code IS NULL AND path_command_course_id IS NULL AND path_command_reused IS NULL)
    OR
    (path_command_kind=$3 AND path_command_expected_version=$4 AND path_command_hash=$5
      AND path_command_payload=$6::jsonb AND path_command_result_code=$8
      AND path_command_course_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM NULLIF($9::text,'')::uuid AND path_command_reused=$10)
  )`, request.ID, claimToken, checkpoint.Command, checkpoint.ExpectedVersion,
		checkpoint.PayloadHash, string(checkpoint.Payload), checkpoint.CheckpointedAt,
		checkpoint.PlannedResultCode, checkpoint.PlannedCourseID, checkpoint.PlannedReused,
		request.CourseFingerprint, request.FingerprintVersion,
		nullableJSON(request.NormalizedContextJSON), nullableJSON(request.GeneratedCourseJSON), now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return nil
}

func (store Store) Complete(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	claimToken string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	tx, err := store.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET status='COMPLETED', result_code=$1, course_id=NULLIF($2::text,'')::uuid, reused=$3,
    course_fingerprint=NULLIF($4::text,''), fingerprint_version=NULLIF($5::text,''),
    normalized_context_json=$6, generated_course_json=$7, learning_path_id=NULLIF($8::text,'')::uuid,
    failure_code='', claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, updated_at=$9, completed_at=$9
WHERE id=$10 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$11`,
		request.ResultCode, request.CourseID, request.Reused, request.CourseFingerprint,
		request.FingerprintVersion, nullableJSON(request.NormalizedContextJSON), nullableJSON(request.GeneratedCourseJSON),
		request.LearningPathID, now, request.ID, claimToken,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	if err := insertCoursePlanEvent(ctx, tx, request, domain.SubjectCoursePlanCompleted, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func (store Store) Retry(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	claimToken string,
	nextAttemptAt time.Time,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	tx, err := store.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET course_fingerprint=NULLIF($1::text,''), fingerprint_version=NULLIF($2::text,''),
    normalized_context_json=$3, generated_course_json=$4, learning_path_id=NULLIF($5::text,'')::uuid,
    claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, next_attempt_at=$6, updated_at=$7
WHERE id=$8 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$9`,
		request.CourseFingerprint, request.FingerprintVersion, nullableJSON(request.NormalizedContextJSON),
		nullableJSON(request.GeneratedCourseJSON), request.LearningPathID, nextAttemptAt, now, request.ID, claimToken,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

func insertCoursePlanEvent(
	ctx context.Context,
	tx pgx.Tx,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	subject string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	event, err := newCoursePlanEvent(request, subject, now)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	_, err = tx.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO planner_outbox(
event_id,subject,schema_version,student_id,correlation_id,causation_id,occurred_at,payload,next_attempt_at,created_at
) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$7,$7) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING`, event.EventID, event.Subject, event.SchemaVersion,
		event.StudentID, event.CorrelationID, event.CausationID, event.OccurredAt, string(event.Payload))
	return err
}

func newCoursePlanEvent(
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	subject string,
	now time.Time,
) (domain.IntegrationEvent, error) {
	eventID := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(request.ID+"\x00"+subject)).String()
	status := domain.CoursePlanCompleted
	if subject == domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed {
		status = domain.CoursePlanFailed
	}
	dataFields := map[string]any{
		"request_id": request.ID, "goal_code": request.GoalCode, "status": status,
		"result_code": request.ResultCode, "course_id": request.CourseID, "reused": request.Reused,
		"failure_code": request.FailureCode, "source": request.Intent.Source, "reason": request.Intent.Reason,
		"audit_refs": request.Intent.AuditRefs,
	}
	if request.LearningPathID != "" {
		dataFields["learning_path_id"] = request.LearningPathID
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(dataFields)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	envelope, err := json.Marshal(domain.EventEnvelope{
		EventID: eventID, EventType: subject, CorrelationID: request.ID,
		CausationID: request.IdempotencyKey, StudentID: request.StudentID,
		OccurredAt: now.UTC(), SchemaVersion: domain.CoursePlanEventSchemaV2, Data: data,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return domain.IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	return domain.IntegrationEvent{
		EventID: eventID, Subject: subject, SchemaVersion: domain.CoursePlanEventSchemaV2,
		StudentID: request.StudentID, CorrelationID: request.ID, CausationID: request.IdempotencyKey,
		OccurredAt: now.UTC(), Payload: envelope,
	}, nil
}

func (store Store) Fail(
	ctx context.Context,
	request domain.CoursePlanRequest,
	claimToken string,
	failureCode string,
	now time.Time,
) error {
	tx, err := store.Pool.Begin(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer tx.Rollback(ctx)
	command, err := tx.Exec(ctx, `
UPDATE course_plan_request
SET status='FAILED', failure_code=$1, course_fingerprint=NULLIF($2::text,''),
    fingerprint_version=NULLIF($3::text,''), normalized_context_json=$4, generated_course_json=$5,
    learning_path_id=NULLIF($6::text,'')::uuid, claim_token=NULL, lease_until=NULL, updated_at=$7, completed_at=$7
WHERE id=$8 AND status='PLANNING' AND claim_token=$9`,
		failureCode, request.CourseFingerprint, request.FingerprintVersion,
		nullableJSON(request.NormalizedContextJSON), nullableJSON(request.GeneratedCourseJSON), request.LearningPathID,
		now, request.ID, claimToken,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if command.RowsAffected() != 1 {
		return domain.ErrConflict
	}
	request.FailureCode = failureCode
	if err := insertCoursePlanEvent(ctx, tx, request, domain.SubjectCoursePlanFailed, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit(ctx)
}

type rowScanner interface {
	Scan(...any) error
}

func scanCoursePlan(row rowScanner) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error) {
	var request domain.CoursePlanRequest
	var learningPathID, diagnosticPlanID, courseID, fingerprint, fingerprintVersion, claimToken sql.NullString
	var pathCommandKind, pathCommandHash, pathCommandResultCode, pathCommandCourseID sql.NullString
	var pathCommandExpectedVersion sql.NullInt64
	var pathCommandReused sql.NullBool
	var leaseUntil, completedAt, pathCommandCheckpointedAt sql.NullTime
	var intentJSON, normalizedContext, generatedCourse, pathCommandPayload []byte
	err := row.Scan(
		&request.ID, &request.StudentID, &request.IdempotencyKey, &request.RequestHash,
		&request.GoalCode, &learningPathID, &intentJSON, &request.Status, &request.ResultCode, &courseID, &request.Reused,
		&fingerprint, &fingerprintVersion, &normalizedContext, &generatedCourse, &request.FailureCode,
		&request.Attempts, &claimToken, &leaseUntil, &request.NextAttemptAt,
		&request.CreatedAt, &request.UpdatedAt, &completedAt,
		&pathCommandKind, &pathCommandExpectedVersion, &pathCommandHash, &pathCommandPayload, &pathCommandCheckpointedAt,
		&pathCommandResultCode, &pathCommandCourseID, &pathCommandReused, &diagnosticPlanID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, err
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(intentJSON, &request.Intent); err != nil {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, err
	}
	if learningPathID.Valid {
		request.LearningPathID = learningPathID.String
	}
	if diagnosticPlanID.Valid {
		request.DiagnosticPlanID = diagnosticPlanID.String
	}
	if courseID.Valid {
		request.CourseID = courseID.String
	}
	if fingerprint.Valid {
		request.CourseFingerprint = fingerprint.String
	}
	if fingerprintVersion.Valid {
		request.FingerprintVersion = fingerprintVersion.String
	}
	if len(normalizedContext) > 0 {
		request.NormalizedContextJSON = append(json.RawMessage(nil), normalizedContext...)
	}
	if len(generatedCourse) > 0 {
		request.GeneratedCourseJSON = append(json.RawMessage(nil), generatedCourse...)
	}
	if claimToken.Valid {
		request.ClaimToken = claimToken.String
	}
	if leaseUntil.Valid {
		value := leaseUntil.Time.UTC()
		request.LeaseUntil = &value
	}
	if completedAt.Valid {
		value := completedAt.Time.UTC()
		request.CompletedAt = &value
	}
	checkpointFields := 0
	for _, present := range []bool{
		pathCommandKind.Valid, pathCommandExpectedVersion.Valid, pathCommandHash.Valid,
		len(pathCommandPayload) > 0, pathCommandCheckpointedAt.Valid, pathCommandResultCode.Valid,
		pathCommandReused.Valid,
	} {
		if present {
			checkpointFields++
		}
	}
	if (checkpointFields == 0 && pathCommandCourseID.Valid) || (checkpointFields != 0 && checkpointFields != 7) {
		return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if checkpointFields == 7 {
		checkpoint, err := domain.NormalizeLearningPathCommandCheckpoint(domain.LearningPathCommandCheckpoint{
			Command: pathCommandKind.String, LearningPathID: request.LearningPathID,
			PlanningRequestID: request.ID, IdempotencyKey: request.ID, ExpectedVersion: pathCommandExpectedVersion.Int64,
			PlannedResultCode: pathCommandResultCode.String, PlannedCourseID: pathCommandCourseID.String,
			PlannedReused: pathCommandReused.Bool,
			PayloadHash:   pathCommandHash.String, Payload: append(json.RawMessage(nil), pathCommandPayload...),
			CheckpointedAt: pathCommandCheckpointedAt.Time,
		}, request.StudentID, request.ID, request.LearningPathID)
		if err != nil {
			return domain.CoursePlanRequest{}, err
		}
		request.LearningPathCommand = &checkpoint
	}
	return request, nil
}

func nullableJSON(input json.RawMessage) any {
	if len(input) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return string(input)
}

func mustJSON(input any) string {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(input)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return string(payload)
}

func prefixedCoursePlanColumns(prefix string) string {
	return prefix + `.id, ` + prefix + `.student_id, ` + prefix + `.idempotency_key, ` +
		prefix + `.request_hash, ` + prefix + `.goal_code, ` + prefix + `.learning_path_id, ` + prefix + `.intent_json, ` +
		prefix + `.status, ` +
		prefix + `.result_code, ` + prefix + `.course_id, ` + prefix + `.reused, ` +
		prefix + `.course_fingerprint, ` + prefix + `.fingerprint_version, ` +
		prefix + `.normalized_context_json, ` + prefix + `.generated_course_json, ` +
		prefix + `.failure_code, ` + prefix + `.attempts, ` +
		prefix + `.claim_token, ` + prefix + `.lease_until, ` + prefix + `.next_attempt_at, ` +
		prefix + `.created_at, ` + prefix + `.updated_at, ` + prefix + `.completed_at, ` +
		prefix + `.path_command_kind, ` + prefix + `.path_command_expected_version, ` +
		prefix + `.path_command_hash, ` + prefix + `.path_command_payload, ` + prefix + `.path_command_checkpointed_at, ` +
		prefix + `.path_command_result_code, ` + prefix + `.path_command_course_id, ` + prefix + `.path_command_reused, ` + prefix + `.diagnostic_plan_id`
}

var _ repository.CoursePlanRepository = Store{}
